name: Northern Peripheral Road (Delhi–Gurugram)

timeline.event: 10 km Delhi section, including the airport tunnel, inaugurated (17 August), completing the expressway

history: The Dwarka Expressway, also called the Northern Peripheral Road, gives Delhi and Gurugram a second fast link besides the always-crowded NH 48. Long stretches run high above the ground on a single row of pillars, and near the Delhi end the road dives into a tunnel that connects towards Indira Gandhi International Airport. The Haryana part opened in March 2024 and the Delhi part in August 2025.
facts: Long stretches run on a wide elevated carriageway carried on a single row of pillars.
The Delhi end includes an 8-lane tunnel about 3.6 km long that links towards IGI Airport.
Passes Yashobhoomi, the big convention centre in Dwarka.
The 10 km Delhi section alone cost about ₹5,360 crore.
